question: can a gapless node of the 2x2x2 cell be conical?
no_go: no linear term exists for any single irrep of O_h at a momentum whose little group contains inversion: Hom(T1u, D x D*) = 0 for all ten irreps
construction: a parity-degenerate A1g+T1u pair at Gamma gives an exactly gapless, exactly isotropic, non-abelian cone
